scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
A human?!
This land is full
of your kind. What
brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
人类？！
这片土地上到处都是你们这些家伙。
你来这里干什么？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
远离家乡，住在米德加尔特就已经够难受了，还得面对你这种啰啰嗦嗦的人类。
别来烦我！

scripts.text: Ask him about Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 打听矮人的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he is doing.
scripts.translation: 问他在做什么

scripts.text: Request weapon creation.
scripts.translation: 请求打造武器

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
What's to know about Dwarves?
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
how harsh the environment may be.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
矮人有什么好打听的？
我们是最坚韧的种族，无论环境多么恶劣，都能活下去。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
Try to imagine.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你们肯定无法想象，在我的故乡生活有多难熬。凭你那点脑子，恐怕更是想不明白...不过还是试着想象一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你们人类引以为傲的大部分知识和技能，很可能都是矮人传授给你们的。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
锻造尤其如此。
就连众神的器具和武器，也是我的祖先打造的。
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我们拥有最渊博的知识和最高超的技艺，却也认命了，甘愿住在巨人那寒冷贫瘠的土地上。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
here so I can kick their ass!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你问我在这里做什么？
呜哈哈哈！
我就等着那些蠢到自己送上门来的人类，好揍他们一顿！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
each other.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
别怕，跟你这种弱者动手，只会丢我自己的脸。
人类明明如此脆弱，却偏偏傲慢自大，整天自相残杀。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你们这个种族，真是没救了。
我连和人类住在同一片大陆上都不愿意！
唉，可惜没得选。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
The path to my hometown
disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
一千年前的战争过后，通往我家乡的路就消失了。不知为何，我再也找不到穿过世界树回家的路...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'm stuck here in Midgard.
At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我被困在了米德加尔特。
幸好找到了这个洞穴。
毕竟，我们矮人还是住在地下最自在。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
我需要一些材料才能为你打造武器。你具体想要什么？

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神项链

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰带

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼尔之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold^000000
1 Necklace^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF4个芙蕾雅宝石
4个银饰品
3个雪之结晶
3个涟漪
3个流动之风
2个蓝宝石
3个珍珠
10个蛋白石
5个诅咒红宝石
20个金块^000000
1条项链^000000...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
不过，打造女神项链的时机还没到。
等封印解除再说吧。
呜哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF1个魔法铁链
20个金块
10个蓝宝石
10个神之金属
1个腰带^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
不过，雷神腰带的封印还没解除。
在那之前，你就等着吧！
哈哈哈!

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF3个未知的锯齿轮子
5根天使之翼羽毛
3个鱼之灵魂
4个太阳神徽章
3份灵魂之息
20个金块
10个铝
1双开槽长靴^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
即便如此，封印未解除前，我也造不出史雷普尼尔之靴。人类，你只能自认倒霉了。
哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF2个托尔护手
4个铁处女
5个瓦尔基里的愤怒
5个暴风雨预兆
5个波浪
20个神之金属
5个铝
40个金块
1把眩晕之锤^000000...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
封印还在，我连雷神之锤的仿品都造不出来。
等封印解除再说吧。
哈哈!

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我们矮人自有尊严，怎么能在低贱的人类面前卖弄技艺！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
别烦我了，快滚出去！去跟那些魔物玩吧，你这个头脑简单的蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'll only present
my magnificent skills
to a human of incredibly
high standing!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我只会在地位极其崇高的人类面前，展示我精湛的技艺！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although I hate
most humans, I have
no choice but to respect the ones chosen by destiny. Go and bring your ^0000FFguildmaster^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我虽然讨厌大多数人类，但命运选中的人，我也得尊重。
去把你们的^0000FF公会会长^000000叫来！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although it is very humiliating to present my valuable skills to a human being...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
虽然向人类展示我宝贵的技艺是一件非常屈辱的事情...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
All the seals have been released, and he who holds the Emperium is chosen by destiny. I have no choice but to respect you.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
所有封印都已解除，而持有华丽金属的人，正是命运的选中者。
我也只能对你以礼相待。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
First of all, I shall confirm whether or not you have brought all the necessary materials to forge a godly item! I hate it when humans come here without any purpose!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
先让我看看，你有没有带齐打造神器所需的材料！
我最讨厌人类无事登门！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFBrisingamen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造^0000FF女神项链^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMegingjard^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造^0000FF雷神腰带^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFSleipnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造^0000FF史雷普尼尔之靴^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMjolnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造^0000FF雷神之锤^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......

[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......
.........

[Dwarf Grunburti]
How dare you come here unprepared?! Did you forget what you needed to bring? Listen carefully this time!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
竟敢毫无准备就来找我？！
忘了要带什么了吗？
这次给我听清楚！

scripts.translation: 女神项链

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰带

Hmmm, but now
that the seals have
been released, you must hurry before another human can claim
one of the godly items...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯，既然封印已经解除了，就得抓紧，别让其他人类抢先拿到神器...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hurry...!
Once I forge
Brisingamen,
the seals will
activate again!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
快点...！
女神项链一旦造好，封印就会重新生效！

the seals will
activate again!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
快点...！
雷神之锤一旦造好，封印就会重新生效！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmpf.
I can't get any work done in here. Come with me to the ^0000FFunderground laboratory^000000 as my guest, human.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哼，在这里根本没法干活。
人类，跟我到^0000FF地下实验室^000000去，这次就当你是我的客人。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now hurry up! ^0000FFOnly one of each godly item^000000 will be given to the humans ^FF0000right after all the seals are released^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
快点！
^0000FF每种神器都只有一件^000000，会在^FF0000所有封印刚解除时^000000交给人类！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahahahaha!
Out of my sight,
you dirty, filthy
human...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈哈！
从我眼前消失，你这肮脏的人类...！

scripts.text:
[Entrance Notice]
Only the most
worthy of humans
will possess the
power of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[入口告示]
只有最优秀的人类才能拥有神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
One of the godly
items has been created,
and the seals have been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
已经有一件神器打造完成，封印也恢复了。等所有封印再次解除，你才能继续...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈哈！
虽然你只是个人类，我都有点同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How in the...
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
怎么...
给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How did one of you
stupid humans get in
here?! Only those who
hold the Emperium can
even think of entering
this place...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你这种蠢人类怎么进来的？！
只有持有华丽金属的人，才有资格踏进这里...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
It's incredibly
humiliating to do work for a human. But since destiny has chosen you as the bearer of an Emperium, I have no choice but to oblige your requests.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
替人类干活，简直是奇耻大辱。
不过，既然命运让你成为华丽金属的持有者，我也只能照你的要求办。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We only have
^FF000010 minutes^000000 to recreate one godly treasure. After that, the seals will restore themselves and I won't be able to create anything until they're released again...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我们只有^FF000010分钟^000000来重铸一件神器。
之后封印会自行恢复，只有再次解除封印，我才能继续打造神器...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^FF0000Don't be too slow^000000,
otherwise ^FF0000I will give
the chance to another
human^000000 right away!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
^FF0000动作别太慢^000000，否则^FF0000我会马上把机会让给另一个人类^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now...!
Choose the item
you wish for me
to create!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
现在...！
选吧，要我打造哪一件！

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神项链

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰带

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼尔之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
B-Brisingamen?!
I've never expected
such insolence...!
This necklace will never have any meaning in my eyes unless it's worn by the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
女、女神项链？！
竟然提出如此无礼的要求...！
在我眼里，这条项链只有戴在女神芙蕾雅身上才有意义。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But who am I to judge your worthiness? These treasures
select their owners with their own will. Let's see if Brisingamen will find you worthy!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
不过，你有没有资格，也轮不到我来评判。
这些宝物有自己的意志，会自行选择主人。
就看看女神项链认不认可你吧！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
再说一遍，重铸这件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold
1 Necklace^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
^0000FF4个芙蕾雅宝石
4个银饰品
3个雪之结晶
3个涟漪
3个流动之风
2个蓝宝石
3个珍珠
10个蛋白石
5个诅咒红宝石
20个金块
1条项链^000000

scripts.text: Make Brisingamen.
scripts.translation: 制作女神项链

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Never in my wildest
imaginings have I thought that I'd be crafting this masterpiece for a mere human. Give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我做梦也没想到，竟会为区区一个人类打造这件杰作。稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
可是...
封印刚刚恢复了。
你得等它们再次全部解除...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈哈！
虽然你只是个人类，我都有点同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Ah, just look at this dazzling beauty. No other piece of jewelry complemented Freya as well as Brisingamen.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
啊，看看这耀眼的光彩。
没有哪件珠宝比女神项链更能衬托芙蕾雅的美。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Brisingamen!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
愚蠢的人类！
重铸女神项链的材料没带齐！
快去拿...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈~
我就知道你会打退堂鼓，人类！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
M- Megingjard?!
The girdle of might?!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
雷、雷神腰带？！
那条力量之带？！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
This belt was worn long ago by Thor, the mightest warrior ever. But since these treasures select their owners, we'll see whether or not it recognizes you as worthy!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
这条腰带曾属于最强大的战士托尔。
不过，宝物会自行选择主人，就看看它认不认可你吧！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
再说一遍，重铸这件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
^0000FF1个魔法铁链
20个金块
10个蓝宝石
10个神之金属
1个腰带^000000...

scripts.text: Make Megingjard.
scripts.translation: 制作雷神腰带

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Twenty years ago,
I'd never believe that
something so powerful and dangerous as Megingjard would end up in the hands of a human...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
二十年前，我绝不会相信像雷神腰带这样强大而危险的宝物会落入人类手中...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
可是...
封印刚刚恢复了。
你得等它们再次全部解除...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈哈！
虽然你只是个人类，我都有点同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Here...
Be careful with how
you use the strength
of a god. Just a fair
warning, human...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
拿去...
神的力量可不能乱用。
人类，我先提醒你一句...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Megingjard!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
愚蠢的人类！
重铸雷神腰带的材料没带齐！
快去拿...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈~
我就知道你会打退堂鼓，人类！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Sleipnir...
Now, understand
that I can't create
the eight-legged stallion
of legend. However...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
史雷普尼尔...
先说清楚，我可造不出传说中的八足骏马。
不过...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I can create a pair
of shoes that will possess the power of Sleipnir. It's a strange, but feasible process...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我能造一双鞋，让它拥有史雷普尼尔的力量。
做法虽然古怪，却确实可行...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
再说一遍，重铸这件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF3个未知的锯齿轮子
5根天使之翼羽毛
3个鱼之灵魂
4个太阳神徽章
3份灵魂之息
20个金块
10个铝
1双开槽长靴^000000...

scripts.text: Make Sleipnir.
scripts.translation: 制作史雷普尼尔之靴

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I never believed
that the speed of
Sleipnir would be
used by a human.
Give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
真没想到，史雷普尼尔的神速竟然会为人类所用。
稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
可是...
封印刚刚恢复了。
你得等它们再次全部解除...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈哈！
虽然你只是个人类，我都有点同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
There...
Wear these, and
move with the speed of
the legendary Sleipnir...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
好了...
穿上它，便能像传说中的史雷普尼尔一样迅捷...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Sleipnir!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
愚蠢的人类！
重铸史雷普尼尔之靴的材料没带齐！
快去拿...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哇哈哈哈~
我就知道你会打退堂鼓，人类！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
M-M-Mjolnir!?
Even though the
moment is at hand,
I can scarcely believe...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
雷、雷、雷神之锤？！
事到临头，我却还是不敢相信...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This is almost a disgrace to gods and the Dwarf race. But perhaps, wielding Mjolnir may be your destiny...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
这简直让众神和矮人蒙羞。
但也许，挥舞雷神之锤就是你的命运...

Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce

scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]

scripts.text:

^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF2个托尔护手
4个铁处女
5个瓦尔基里的愤怒
5个暴风雨预兆
5个波浪
20个神之金属
5个铝
40个金块
1把眩晕之锤^000000...

scripts.text: Make Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 打造雷神之锤

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Do not disgrace
Thor, lord of Thunder,
or you will regret it.
Mark my words...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
不要玷污雷神托尔的名誉，否则你会后悔的。
记住我的话...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
可是...
封印刚刚恢复了。
你得等它们再次全部解除...！

scripts.translation:

哇哈哈哈哈！
虽然你只是个人类，我都有点同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
It's done.
Take it. How does
it feel to hold the world's most powerful weapon in your grasp?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
完成了。
拿去吧。手握世界上最强大的武器，感觉如何？

scripts.text:

You didn't bring

Hurry...!
scripts.translation:

重铸雷神之锤的材料没带齐！
快去拿...！
